tools.name: convert_table
tools.description: Convert a table from CSV, TSV or JSON into CSV, TSV, JSON (array of objects) or a Markdown table. Cell values are kept as text. Use when the user wants the same table in another format. Do NOT use to trim, dedupe or drop rows; use clean_table.

tools.name: clean_table
tools.description: Clean a table: trim whitespace in cells, drop fully empty rows, and optionally remove duplicate rows; returns the table in the same format with before/after row counts. Use when preparing messy pasted data. Do NOT use to change format; use convert_table.

tools.name: column_stats
tools.description: Compute one statistic over a single column: sum, avg, min or max (numeric, rounded to 2 dp, blanks ignored), count of non-empty cells, or the sorted distinct values. Use for quick answers like 'total of the price column'. Do NOT use to reshape the table; use split_column or convert_table.

tools.name: split_column
tools.description: Split one column into several columns on a delimiter (e.g. 'full name' on a space), inserted in place; short rows are padded with empty cells. Returns the table in the same format. Use when one column packs several values. Do NOT use to clean or change format; use clean_table or convert_table.
